name: Geyadrone Dihada
description: A devious, power-hungry and untrustworthy shapeshifting conqueror and planeswalker who quickly betrayed her word once she gained an advantage.

timeline.summary: After weeks of searching, Ulf finds a mildewed book about Sol'kanar, the Demon King of Corondor, and Dihada's curse.
timeline.quote: Sol'kanar, the Demon King of Corondor.

timeline.summary: Jared kills Brotten, who says Dihada is waiting for him.
timeline.quote: "She's waiting for you, Jared. Return to her."

timeline.summary: Dihada, sensing the Ember of Dakkon's unignited Spark, offers to make him a planeswalker if he forges her a soul-drinking sword.
timeline.quote: she offered to make him a Planeswalker if he would forge her a soul-drinking sword.

timeline.summary: Dihada returns to claim the finished sword and keeps her word, igniting Dakkon's Spark.
timeline.quote: She kept her word, igniting Dakkon’s Spark and unlocking his power as a Planeswalker.

timeline.summary: Dihada betrays Dakkon by absorbing his shadow and soul into the blade.
timeline.quote: she quickly betrayed him by absorbing his shadow (and his soul) into the blade.

timeline.summary: Dihada uses her shapeshifting abilities to manipulate those around her, laying the groundwork of her plans years in advance.
timeline.quote: She used her shapeshifting abilities to manipulate those around her, often laying the groundwork of her plans many years in advance.

relations.note: Cursed him and made him her demonic servant.
relations.quote: until he was cursed by the Planeswalker Geyadrone Dihada.

relations.note: She betrayed him after he forged her sword.
relations.quote: she quickly betrayed him by absorbing his shadow (and his soul) into the blade.

pages_say.description: A planeswalker who cursed Sol'kanar and who is said to be waiting for Jared.
A demon planeswalker who bargained with Dakkon to forge her a soul-drinking sword, then absorbed his shadow and soul into it.
A devious, power-hungry and untrustworthy shapeshifting conqueror and planeswalker who quickly betrayed her word once she gained an advantage.
